Taiwanese President Lai Ching-te, other government officials, and industry representatives at the Semicon Network Summit, ahead of Semicon Taiwan, September 1, 2026, in Taipei, Taiwan. Credit: Taiwan Presidential Office via Flickr

From advanced packaging tools to specialized materials, over 1,300 chipmakers and suppliers showcased their most sophisticated offerings at a major semiconductor trade show in Taiwan’s capital Taipei last week. Also on full display: the island’s chip diplomacy efforts.
